question: Where does MetroMart stand against its FY2026-27 growth rebate tiers, and what would it take to reach the top tier?
ground_truth: YTD (like-for-like weeks) net sell-in INR 551,426,064 vs INR 489,378,557 last year = 12.7 % growth: qualifies for the 2.0 % tier (>= 8 %), not the 3.5 % tier (>= 15 %) per TTA-MM-FY27 s2. FY2025-26 total was INR 761,402,410, so 15 % needs INR 875,612,771; remaining weeks must deliver INR 324,186,707 vs INR 272,023,853 last year, i.e. about 19.2 % growth for the rest of the year.

question: Recommend a promotion for MetroMart that helps close the rebate gap and complies with our trade policy. Justify it with data and documents.
ground_truth: Example good answer: price-off on ZS-250 in West at MetroMart, depth <= 25 % (e.g. 20 %), 2-3 weeks, no overlap and >= 4-week gap, inside co-funding cap. Evidence: ZS-250 averages 38.7 % promo uplift (only MC-110 is higher at 51.5 %, and those were festive-season promos so the baseline understates demand), MetroMart West ZS-250 promos averaged 42.2 % uplift with ROI about 1.40 vs the 1.2 threshold (MetroMart co-funds 50 %); sugar-free energy +22 % (West +29 %) in Market Pulse Q3; ZS-250 is a JBP focus SKU. Must be booked >= 6 weeks ahead (calendar lock) and approved by the KAM.

question: Why did the QuickBasket Citrus Fizz 600ml promotion in South in August 2026 underperform?
ground_truth: Uplift only 6.7 % (vs 26.6 % for the same promo in Aug 2025). Causes: Fizzora 600ml launched in South 3-4 Aug at INR 30 vs INR 40 with QuickBasket banner from 10 Aug (competitor brief); and zero closing stock at QuickBasket South in weeks of 17 and 24 Aug (stock-outs) - also exposes Verdant to the 2 % fill-rate penalty in TTA-QB-FY27.

question: Is the planned promotion PRM-2612 compliant with our trade policy and the MetroMart agreement?
ground_truth: No. PRM-2612 (MetroMart North ZU-250, 14-27 Dec 2026, 30 % price-off): depth 30 % > 25 % cap needs Commercial Director approval (POL-TS-01 s1); overlaps PRM-2524 (same SKU/account/region, 7-20 Dec) and breaks the 4-week gap (s2); starts inside MetroMart's 6-week calendar lock (TTA-MM-FY27 s3) as of 2026-11-20.

question: What are QuickBasket's payment terms and stock-out penalties?
ground_truth: Payment 30 days from invoice; target dark-store fill rate 95 %, below that a 2 % penalty on that week's PO value; stock-outs during funded promos get joint review (TTA-QB-FY27).

question: Which SKU had the worst forecast accuracy over the last 12 weeks, and why?
ground_truth: CP-200 with WAPE 23.9 % (next: CF-600 7.3 %). The seasonality outlook notes the statistical forecast lacks a monsoon factor for Hydration, so planners should override.

question: How is promotion ROI defined and what is the minimum acceptable ROI?
ground_truth: ROI = incremental gross margin / trade spend, incremental gross margin = (actual - baseline cases) x gross margin per case; minimum 1.2 for repeat mechanics; below 1.0 on two consecutive runs -> discontinue (POL-TS-01 s3).
